props.description:
At any moment, if you have a full set of Soul Beads, you may spend 40 MP and imbue one equipped weapon with them. Until this effect ends, the weapon gains a +3 bonus to Accuracy Checks, and its damage ignores Resistances.

If it’s a melee weapon, it also becomes a ranged weapon, and its attacks can be launched from afar. If you have that weapon equipped while activating this effect, you may perform a free 【⚔️ Attack】 with it as part of the same action.

You lose access to the Soul Beads used, and they don’t count toward the Clarity Skill while imbued in your weapon. You can generate Soul Beads as normal from the next turn onwards. Only one weapon can benefit from this Skill at a time.
props.heroic_requirement: You must have mastered the Monk Class
props.name: Beaded Weapon
